main.description: A cook's statement that an ingredient line NAME (as arecipe reports it once quantity and preparation come off — "freeze-dried strawberry") means the canonical ingredient KEY ("strawberry") in arecipe's shipped vocabulary. One record per name. Published from a device's confirmed corrections; read back by the cook's other devices, and by arecipe's vocabulary build from accounts it trusts, as alias candidates for review. Never authoritative on its own: a reader keys the name to a key it already has.

name.description: The unmatched ingredient name, lower-case, whitespace-collapsed.

key.description: The canonical ingredient key the name means.
